questions.q: What does The China Study claim about plant proteins and cancer cells?
a: Plant proteins reduce cancer cell attraction
questions.why: Study says cells fed plant proteins are less likely to attract cancer cells.

questions.q: According to the book, whose diet showed lower cancer rates in rural China?
questions.why: Rural areas with low animal protein had fewer cancer cases.

questions.q: What misconception about protein does the book challenge?
a: We need more protein than we actually do
questions.why: It states we don't need as much protein as commonly believed.

questions.q: Which diet is described as popular among fitness enthusiasts for its high protein?
questions.why: Paleo is noted for high protein intake favored by fitness freaks.

questions.q: What does the book suggest is a more reliable path to health than medical interventions?
questions.why: It argues health is a matter of nutrition, not medicine.
